title: Promotional cut header prints '0 frames derived' + points at the view you're on
body:
## Summary
On every trailer and no-spine project the Frames header renders `0 frames derived from "<title>" (<engineLabel>)`, which is the exact "empty count reads as nothing done" defect FramesStep's own comment says this file was changed to forbid. The engineLabel suffixes then narrate the app: "— see the shots view" while the shots view is forced and already open, and "— Step 2 composes it" directly above the <UpstreamBreak> that draws the same thing.

## Description
FramesStep.tsx:73-79 is the spec: a promotional cut has `frames = []` by construction (frames.ts:400) and drawing a 0-count "reads as 'nothing done yet' when the truth is 'this step does not work that way here'". The fix it records only re-routed the view (:87-88); the header line at :155-157 still interpolates `ctl.frames.length` unconditionally. For a trailer it renders e.g. `0 frames derived from "X" (Trailer · 12 beats — see the shots view)`; for no-spine `0 frames derived from "X" (no spine composed yet — Step 2 composes it)` stacked over ShotSheet.tsx:147-153's UpstreamBreak(blockedAt="script"). Both suffixes are sentences whose subject is the app. ShotSheet already carries the real counts as <Tally> chips (ShotSheet.tsx:213-215).

## Flow
- Open Frames on a trailer project -> view forced to shots -> header reads "0 frames derived ... — see the shots view" above the shots table.
- Open Frames on a new trailer project with no spine -> header says "no spine composed yet — Step 2 composes it" and the UpstreamBreak under it says it again.

## Expected impact
Removes a false zero and two self-narrating clauses from the first line every trailer creator reads on this step; the shots view's own Tally row becomes the only count.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a trailer creator is not told "0 frames" about a step that does not derive frames for them
Before: 2 of 3 origins (trailer-cut, no-spine) render a 0-count header; 2 engineLabel strings carry an app-subject clause (frames.ts:354, :380)
After: 0 origins render a 0-count; 0 app-subject clauses in FramesRender.engineLabel
Method: probe - source ratchet over stripped FramesStep.tsx / frames.ts
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: app/_phases/frames/FramesStep.tsx:73-79 (spec comment), :87-88 (promotionalCut forces shots), :155-157 (`{ctl.frames.length} frames derived from ... ({ctl.render.engineLabel})`, unconditional); app/_phases/frames/frames.ts:400 (framesFor returns [] unless explainer-fixture); frames.ts:354 (`... beats — see the shots view`), frames.ts:380 (`no spine composed yet — Step 2 composes it`); app/_phases/frames/ShotSheet.tsx:147-153 (UpstreamBreak for no-spine), :213-215 (Tally shots/beats/checks). grep 'engineLabel' over app/ lib/ tests/: the only reader of FramesRender.engineLabel is FramesStep.tsx:156 (useFrames.ts:94 is the placeholder; the other hits are script ScriptRender.engineLabel). grep of tests/ for 'see the shots view|Step 2 composes it|frames derived from': 0 hits.
verify: Write tests/golden-path/frames-header-honesty.probe.spec.ts first: (1) stripComments(FramesStep.tsx) — the JSX that interpolates `ctl.frames.length` must sit inside a `!promotionalCut &&` guard: assert /!promotionalCut\s*&&[\s\S]{0,200}ctl\.frames\.length/ matches; (2) stripComments(frames.ts) contains neither 'see the shots view' nor 'Step 2 composes it'. Red on HEAD, green after. Fix: wrap FramesStep.tsx:155-157 in `{!promotionalCut && (...)}`; change frames.ts:354 to `${templateOf(opts.template as TemplateId).label} · ${beats.length} beats` and :380 to `no spine composed yet`. Then npm run typecheck && npm test.

title: Frame text input has no accessible name; two textareas named only by placeholder
body:
## Summary In the expanded assembly row, each frame text is edited through an `` with no label, no aria-label and no placeholder — a screen reader announces "edit text" with nothing to say whether it is the caption, the figure or the label. The plate-subject and clip-motion textareas are named only by their placeholder, and the visible headings above them ("plate subject", "clip motion") are `

` elements not associated with the control. ## Description The sibling controls on the same rows were already fixed and say why: the fact `
evidence: app/_phases/frames/FramesAssembly.tsx:390-395 (span role word + `` — no aria-label, no placeholder, no
verify: Probe first: tests/golden-path/frames-control-names.probe.spec.ts reads stripComments(FramesAssembly.tsx), finds every `<input`, `<textarea`, `<select` opening tag (through its closing `>`/`/>`), and asserts each contains `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. title: Unsourced-figure dot is colour+glyph only, and the concept has four names
body:
## Summary
The integrity mark this step exists for — a figure not bound to a notebook fact — is drawn as an amber `●` with a native `title` on the canvas (parts.tsx:335) and in the layer list (LayerPanel.tsx:178). Neither has an accessible name: in LayerPanel the dot sits inside the row's select `<button>`, so the button's name ends in "black circle"; a descendant's `title` never enters the name. The same concept is spelled four ways across sibling surfaces of one row.

## Description
Names in use: "unsourced figure" (FramesAssembly.tsx:146, header count), "not bound to a notebook fact" (parts.tsx:335 title), "figure with no fact behind it" (LayerPanel.tsx:178 title), "— cites no fact —" (FramesAssembly.tsx:418 option). LayerPanel's own comment (:165-167) says colour-only state needs a non-colour channel (it added aria-pressed for selection) — the warn dot in the same row was not given one. Native title is also unreachable on touch and keyboard (signal/README: "<Hint> — a real disclosure, not title=").

## Flow
- Screen reader in LayerPanel: "figure 42%  black circle, toggle button, not pressed" — the defect is unannounced.
- Sighted touch user: amber dot, no way to learn what it means.

## Expected impact
The step's integrity signal reaches non-visual users, and the header count, the canvas mark and the layer mark use one word for one concept.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a screen-reader user hears that a figure is unsourced where it is marked
Before: 2 warn marks with 0 accessible text; 4 distinct names for one concept in the context
After: 2 marks each with aria-hidden glyph + sr-only "unsourced"; marks and header share the word "unsourced"
Method: probe - source ratchet over stripped parts.tsx / LayerPanel.tsx
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: app/_phases/frames/parts.tsx:334-338 (`●`); app/_phases/frames/LayerPanel.tsx:168-182 (dot inside the select
verify: Extend (or create) tests/golden-path/frames-control-names.probe.spec.ts: for stripComments(parts.tsx) and stripComments(LayerPanel.tsx), every span whose text is '●' carries aria-hidden, and each file contains an sr-only span with text 'unsourced'; neither file contains 'not bound to a notebook fact' or 'figure with no fact behind it'. Red on HEAD. Fix at both sites: `●unsourced` and drop the title= (no new visible prose). npm test && npm run check:narration.

title: Music-video poster that can't be shown dead-ends: blank, or 're-generate' with no button
body:
## Summary
Once a music-video project has a `posterAssetId`, the generate controls never render again (MusicVideoFrames.tsx:118 gates them on `!comp.posterAssetId`). Two branches downstream then strand the creator: if the poster's bytes do not resolve (`loadPosterAsset` returns null or rejects — asset evicted, upload blob gone) the studio branch at :151 requires `posterUrl` and draws NOTHING — the page is three Tally chips and empty space, forever, identical to "still loading"; and the incomplete branch at :162-166 tells the user to "re-generate the poster" while no control to do so is on screen.

## Description
Comment-as-spec: the copy at :164 names a remedy; the JSX that could perform it is behind a condition that is false in exactly that branch. Meanwhile usePhaseReport (:90-94) reports the step "done" because `posterAssetId` exists, so the pipeline rail shows Frames complete while the step can show neither the poster nor a way to make one. `loadPosterAsset(...)` is fired with `void` and no catch (:65), so a rejected IndexedDB read is an unhandled rejection rather than a state. FramesStep's standard branch handles the analogous case (unreadable record) with a Notice + reload control (FramesStep.tsx:108-133).

## Flow
- Poster asset missing -> loadPosterAsset resolves null -> posterUrl stays null -> no EffectsStudio, no generate button, no message.
- seed/effectParams missing -> amber "re-generate the poster" -> user looks for a button -> none.

## Expected impact
A creator whose poster is unreachable can make a new one; no music-video Frames state is a blank page.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every music-video Frames state offers either the studio or the generate control
Before: 2 reachable branches (posterUrl unresolved; params/seed missing) render no actionable control; 1 of them renders nothing at all
After: 0 — the generate block renders whenever the composition is not renderable, and an unresolved poster is a stated state
Method: probe - source ratchet over stripped MusicVideoFrames.tsx (generate guard + loadPosterAsset null/rejection branch)
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: app/_phases/frames/music-video/MusicVideoFrames.tsx:118 (`{!comp.posterAssetId && (` gates style input + generate button), :151 (studio requires `posterUrl`), :162-166 ('this composition is missing its seed or effect parameters — re-generate the poster.' with no button in that branch), :58-85 (posterUrl only set when loadPosterAsset resolves non-null; `void loadPosterAsset(...).then(...)` no catch), :90-94 (phase reported 'done' on posterAssetId alone); app/_phases/frames/music-video/useMusicVideoComposition.ts:198-205 (loadPosterAsset returns null on missing asset/pointer/blob). Contrast app/_phases/frames/FramesStep.tsx:108-133.
verify: Probe first: tests/golden-path/music-video-frames-states.probe.spec.ts over stripComments(MusicVideoFrames.tsx) asserts (a) the generate block containing data-testid="music-video-generate-poster" is no longer guarded by `!comp.posterAssetId &&` alone — derive `renderable` (posterAssetId && seed !== undefined && effectParams && posterUrl) plus a settled poster-load flag, and render the generate block when `!renderable` after the load settles; (b) the loadPosterAsset call carries `.catch(` (or try/catch) and its null branch sets a state rendered under data-testid="music-video-poster-missing". Red on HEAD. Keep the existing testids; drop the '— re-generate the poster' clause once the button sits beside it (the verb is on the button). Set state only inside the promise callback, as :70-73 already does, so lint:ratchet's set-state-in-effect count does not rise. npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:ratchet.

title: No-envelope state is hand-rolled prose with no route; Script's twin uses UpstreamBreak
body:
## Summary
A music-video project whose track has not been analysed lands on Frames and reads one amber sentence — "no analyzed track yet — attach one in Research before generating a poster." — with no control to get to Research. The same condition one step earlier (MusicVideoScript, ScriptStep.tsx:196-203) is drawn as `<UpstreamBreak blockedAt="research" ... action={{ label: "Open Research", href }}>`, the signal vocabulary's shape for exactly this.

## Description
Pair: two music-video branches of sibling steps, same upstream blocker, two spellings — one the shared drawn pipeline with a real navigation control, one a prose sentence that is a dead end. The signal README names hand-rolled re-teaching of the pipeline as the defect UpstreamBreak exists to remove. Amber here also contradicts UpstreamBreak's severity rule (blocked-by-upstream is `info`, cyan), and "before generating a poster" misdirects when a poster already exists but the envelope record is absent.

## Flow
- New music-video project, Research not finished -> open Frames -> sentence, no link -> user must find the step rail themselves.

## Expected impact
One shape for "blocked on Research" across the music-video branches, with a one-click route to the fix.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - the blocked creator reaches Research in one click
Before: 1 hand-rolled upstream-block sentence in the context with 0 navigation controls (MusicVideoFrames.tsx:103-108); ScriptStep's twin has 1 UpstreamBreak + 1 action
After: 0 hand-rolled; UpstreamBreak with action href `/studio/${projectId}?step=research`
Method: probe - source ratchet: stripped MusicVideoFrames.tsx imports UpstreamBreak and no longer contains 'attach one in Research'
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
app/_phases/frames/music-video/MusicVideoFrames.tsx:103-108 (`

no analyzed track yet — attach one in Research before generating a poster.

`); app/_phases/script/ScriptStep.tsx:196-203 (MusicVideoScript: ``); components/ui/signal/README.md UpstreamBreak section (blocked-by-upstream is info/cyan). grep tests/ for 'music-video-no-envelope': 0 hits.
verify:
In tests/golden-path/music-video-frames-states.probe.spec.ts add: stripComments(MusicVideoFrames.tsx) imports `UpstreamBreak` from '@/components/ui/signal', contains `blockedAt="research"`, `current="frames"` and `step=research`, and does not contain 'attach one in Research'. Red on HEAD. Replace :103-108 with `
` (done={[]} mirrors ScriptStep's twin). npm test && npm run typecheck. NOTE for the director: shares write_set with the poster dead-end finding — build them in one builder.

lens_checked.visual-craft: Read in full FramesStep, FramesAssembly, LayerPanel, ShotSheet, parts, AlternativesView, VariantContactSheet, MusicVideoFrames, EffectsStudio (.tsx; the context has no .css) + components/ui/signal/README.md, Tally/Hint/UpstreamBreak props; compared UpstreamBreak/Notice/Tally usage against sibling ScriptStep/ScoreSpotting music-video branches (finding 5). Noted, not filed: LayerPanel.tsx:184-195 icon buttons rest at text-white/25 (~2.1:1 on slate-950, under WCAG 1.4.11 3:1) and VariantContactSheet.tsx:288 disabled trash at text-white/15.
lens_checked.ux-reviewer: Traced FramesAssembly renderMissing/stoppedWith/pausedUntil + Tally on the button, FramesStep loadTrouble Notice + reload, promotional-cut TabRail lock, alternatives adopt/remove/generate + last-alt guard, music-video poster flow (finding 4).
lens_checked.state-coverage: Per data source: useFrames (loaded/loadTrouble/error/notice — distinct renders), useAlternatives (loaded gate + error line; per-column Ghost on zero alts), ShotSheet (no-spine UpstreamBreak vs not-applicable struck grid vs table), useMusicVideoComposition + loadPosterAsset + envelope (finding 4). Not filed: a FAILED useStepFor read in MusicVideoFrames stays un-hydrated, so 'reading the composition…' (:96-101) shows forever, identical to loading; useStorageTrouble (stepStore.ts:337) has zero component consumers, so there is no in-repo pair to copy yet.
lens_checked.copy-auditor: Diffed header comments as specs against JSX: FramesStep:73-79 vs :156 (finding 1), MusicVideoFrames:164 vs :118 (finding 4), unsourced-figure naming across 4 sites (finding 3). Not filed: VariantContactSheet.tsx:71-77 'loading the sheet…' is unreachable (sole consumer AlternativesView.tsx:37-42 returns 'reading the alternatives…' first).
lens_checked.accessibility-checker: Grepped every <input|<textarea|<select|aria-label|title= in the 9 .tsx (12 title= sites); checked TabRail locked-tab semantics, ResizeHandle slider keyboard (parts.tsx:237-263), Row aria-expanded, AltCard aria-pressed, Scrubber (VariantContactSheet.tsx:147-155: busy/alt-count state is colour + title only, aria-label omits it), EffectsStudio.tsx:205 canvas aria-label without role=img. Filed findings 2 and 3.

lens_no_surface.mobile-specialist: Assembly is a fixed-track desktop ledger (ASSEMBLY_GRID 52px/1fr/244px/120px/86px) and the contact sheet a 68vh horizontal rail; neither is plainly meant to work narrow.
